verdict.text: Verdict - A powerful foldable with technological gaps Review: Honor Magic V2. The review device was provided by Honor. With the Magic V2, Honor has created a very good foldable that is particularly impressive due to its thin and lightweight design. In direct comparison, it feels like a normal smartphone and appears to be less chunky than, for example, an iPhone 15 Pro Max. In addition, Honor has packed its Magic V2, Honor with a wide range of powerful technology. This starts with the batteries which are both thin and long-lasting. This extends to the good camera setup and continues to the eye-friendly displays. With the Magic V2, Honor has demonstrated impressively that a foldable doesn't have to be a bulky slab and can still house tons of technology. However, the Magic V2 isn't perfect since there are a few gaps in its feature set, despite its high price. Among other things, we miss the inclusion of the 6 GHz Wi-Fi band and wireless charging is also absent. What is difficult to understand is why Honor at least doesn't offer the Magic Pen as an optional extra. The V2's strongest competitor remains the which cuts a slightly better figure due to being waterproof and also having better multitasking capabilities. The is a little bit cheaper as long as you go for the smaller storage variant. Likewise, it is waterproof but much heavier and doesn't feel as premium.
